system.longDesc: A rifle in your hands is far more dangerous.
system.requirement: Accuracy (Longarms) focus or Accuracy (Assault Rifles) focus

degree0.desc: Countless hours at the range have taught you to fire accurately from a fixed position. If you are prone or can brace against a sturdy object such as a wall or ledge, you gain +1 to your attack roll. This stacks with the Aim action.

degree1.desc: You trust in your weapon’s power to punch through cover. The attack roll modifier for defender in light cover does not apply to your attacks with a longarm or assault rifle. This includes the penalty from the Human Shield action stunt.

degree2.desc: You push your weapon’s range to the limit. Penalties to the attack roll due to range do not apply to your attacks with a longarm or assault rifle.
